<script>
    if(localStorage.getItem('ZSV')) {
        ZSV_render(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ZSV')));
              console.log("ZSV localStorage - cache");
    }
    function ZSV_render(r) {
        var monthNow = parseFloat(new Date().getMonth() + 1);
        var dayNow = new Date().getDate();
        var msNow = 0;

var msSinceMidnight= new Date()-new Date().setHours(0,0,0,0);

        var hoursNow = new Date().getHours();


        if(hoursNow > 21) {
          msNow = 1;
        } else if(hoursNow < 9) {
          msNow = 0;
        } else {
          // msNow = msSinceMidnight / 24 / 60 / 60 / 1000 / (13 * 1000 * 60);
          // msNow = msSinceMidnight / ( (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) * (13 * 60 * 60 * 1000) )
          //msNow = msSinceMidnight * ( 13 / 24 ) / 24 / 60 / 60 / 1000;
          msNow = (msSinceMidnight - (9 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) * (13 / 24) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
          
          var a = msSinceMidnight;
          var b = a - (9 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
          var c = b * (13 / 24);
          var d = c / (1000 * 60 * 60);
          
          console.log("d", d)
          
          
          var f = hoursNow - 9;
          var g = new Date().getMinutes();
          var h = new Date().getSeconds();
          
          var fgh = (f * 60 * 60 * 1000) + (g * 60 * 1000) + (h * 1000);
          var fghDIV = fgh / 13 / 60 / 60 / 1000;
          
          console.warn(f,g,h, fgh, fghDIV)
          
          var msNow = fghDIV;
         
          console.log(msNow)
        }

        var data = r.feed.entry;
        var sum = 0;

        var donators = {
          active: data[0].gsx$aktivni.$t,
          inactive: data[0].gsx$neaktivni.$t,
          large: data[0].gsx$preko7500.$t
        }

        var graph = {
          active: "bottom: " + donators.inactive / 5000 * 100 + "%; height: " + donators.active / 5000 * 100 + "%",
          inactive: "bottom: " + 0 + "%; height: " + donators.inactive / 5000 * 100 + "%",
          large: "bottom: " + (Number(donators.inactive) + Number(donators.active)) / 5000 * 100 + "%; height: " + donators.large / 5000 * 100 + "%"
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
          var monthSum = parseFloat(data[i].gsx$datum.$t.split('.')[1]);

          if (parseInt(monthSum) === parseInt(monthNow)) {
             var todayNumber = parseFloat(data[i].gsx$datum.$t.split('.')[0]);
             
            if(todayNumber == dayNow) {
                var toAdd = Number(data[i].gsx$kolicina.$t.replace('.', '').replace(',', '')) / 100;
                sum += toAdd * msNow; 
            } else {
                var pricePerDay = data[i].gsx$kolicina.$t;
                sum += Number(pricePerDay.replace('.', '').replace(',', '')) / 100;
            }
          }
          
        }




        document.querySelector('.legend.gold article').innerHTML = donators.large;
        document.querySelector('.legend.blue article').innerHTML = donators.active;
        document.querySelector('.legend.grey article').innerHTML = donators.inactive;

        document.querySelector('.value-grey').style = graph.inactive;
        document.querySelector('.value-blue').style = graph.active;
        document.querySelector('.value-gold').style = graph.large;

        document.querySelector('[za-sva-vrimena-value]').innerHTML = new Intl.NumberFormat('de-DE').format(sum.toFixed(2)) + ' kn';
        document.querySelector('[za-sva-vrimena-graph] > div').style.width = sum / 300000 * 100 + '%';
    }

    fetch('https://spreadsheets.google.com/feeds/list/1p0C1CJdiaqyXuL9KCaYMHYzTyKfOGiaHGdxE77e0fuc/1/public/full?alt=json')
      .then(function (r) { return r.json() }).then(function (r) {
        localStorage.setItem('ZSV', JSON.stringify(r));
              console.log("ZSV localStorage - fetch");
        ZSV_render(r);
      });

    fetch('https://hajduk.hr/api/v1/active-members-number').then(function (r) {
      return r.json();
    }).then(function (r) {
      document.querySelector('[data-number]').setAttribute('data-number', r[0])
    })
  </script>
